correctness.rationale: For a fully alternating arc in unscaled ambient coordinates, the primary vertex construction gives distinct alternating selections. Translating negative coordinates by 1 also makes these zero–one points, each extreme among the listed points. The one-match open/closed block matrix is [[2,1],[1,1]], giving F_(2r+1). For a pair, the squared chord counts exactly the differing bits. It is even since each support has even size. The start and end are both 00, and quotienting the two exchanged states gives the claimed cubic characteristic polynomial and recurrence; the initial terms and generating-function numerator agree. The second shell is genuinely off-diagonal only for r>=2. Its recurrence gives 72 ordered pairs in rank 3 and r^2*2^r for all r>=2, while the leading term is 2^r. Support follows by comparing consecutive-interval matchings to the empty matching. At q=1 the positive transfer has a simple analytic dominant root, a spectral gap and a nonzero start/end eigenprojection; implicit differentiation verifies the two log-root derivatives and strictly positive variance. Taylor expansion proves the normalized CLT, and discarding the diagonal of mass 1/F_(2r+1) leaves the limit unchanged. An independent exact enumeration of 435664 ordered pairs and symbolic cubic/log-derivative checks are reproducible with record1() in /workspace/branches/frozen_metric_replay.py. The discrete tests do not prove the infinite result; the frozen script was read, not run.
